audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with a sharp, clear delivery and high arousal. A bright, mid-tempo electronic pop track with a steady, driving beat plays in the background. The sound of liquid pouring into a glass bowl creates a distinct, soft splashing acoustic texture under the vocals. (2) The main speaker's voice remains friendly and professional with a moderate pitch and high articulation. The background music continues consistently without interruption. Audible sounds of crisp paper and plastic rustling occur as a pastry box is opened, followed by a soft, rhythmic chewing sound. (3) A dialogue ensues between the main speaker and an off-camera male. The main speaker uses a playful, high-arousal tone with varied pitch. Background music maintains its energy floor. Distinct "Mmm" vocalizations indicate positive valence, accompanied by clear mouth sounds associated with tasting food. (4) During the cooking sequence, percussive mashing sounds with a soft, squishy texture are prominently mixed. The metallic click of a bottle cap opening is followed by a steady, low-frequency oil pouring sound. The music swells slightly in volume during this instructional phase to match the visual rhythm. (5) A sudden percussive thud occurs as a glass bowl is placed on a table. The speaker's voice shifts to a humorous, slightly embarrassed tone, followed by the crisp, high-frequency rustling of paper towels. Spontaneous background laughter from an off-camera person is clearly audible in the mix. (6) The sound of an oven door opening and closing features a distinct metallic latch click and resonance. A series of rhythmic thuds follow as a knife cuts through a dense object on a wooden cutting board. The BGM remains steady and upbeat, providing a cohesive rhythmic floor for the scene. (7) The final phase features high-valence vocalizations of excitement from two male voices. The intensity of the speech is high, indicating joy and satisfaction. The background music fades out slightly as the dialogue concludes with a final humorous remark and collective laughter.

It uses a popular food review format combined with a DIY cooking challenge to showcase product features like the stretchable spout and high smoke point, targeting health-conscious home cooks.
